Initial release of hostinger-mcp skill — manage your entire Hostinger infrastructure through the official MCP server.

- Provides operational guidance for VPS, hosting, domains, DNS, email marketing (Reach), and billing with safety-first workflows.
- Enforces strict confirmation for destructive and money-spending operations; requires explicit account and action/cost approval before proceeding.
- Supports multi-account setups with clear per-account resource separation and confirmation.
- Loads only required tool binaries for each task, improving safety and efficiency.
- Includes clear documentation of connection, tool loading, and confirmation protocols.
